name: Hiiragi Nao
source:
A new part-time worker at the convenience store where the main character works. He has a curt attitude whenever anyone talks to him, and has a hard time fitting in at the store. He likes sweets.

[translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9203]Novel Game[/url]]
